fields.Name: T197 - Resilience Invalid Record Navigation
fields.Description: Verifies invalid record/URL navigation does not crash (shows error or recovery prompt).

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to an invalid / non-existent record URL or entity (e.g. open a record then alter it to a clearly-bogus value, or use a known-bad path). Verify the app handles it WITHOUT crashing to a blank white screen — it should show EITHER a clean 'record not found' / error message, OR a recovery prompt (e.g. a 'Taking longer than expected' notice with a 'Reset' button). Either a not-found message or a recovery prompt counts as graceful, non-crashing handling. A fully blank white screen or raw error stack is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The app did NOT crash — it shows a not-found/error message OR a recovery prompt (e.g. a 'Reset' option)
No fully blank white screen or raw error stack
